integrity: Exact self-contained mathematical proof and reproducible stochastic/numerical checker; computational experiments do not establish asymptotic limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex all-ideal polygons in curvature -1; no uniform degeneration result. Two-depth singular limit and midpoint statement weak only; charted six-component law converges in total variation. The previously published scalar rare-distance tail is credited, not new. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Marked cusp-pair and midpoint laws for distant points in ideal hyperbolic polygons
